title: Lightly Spiced Brazilian Chicken Frittata
description: A tangy and silky Brazilian dish perfect for brunch, featuring mirin and mortar-pestle-pounded spices, made with ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a mortar and pestle, pound the cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper into a coarse powder.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, mirin, and coconut milk.
Add the pounded spice mixture to the egg mixture and whisk until well combined.
Heat the cooking oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the diced chicken breast to the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through.
Add the chopped scallions to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Pour the egg mixture over the chicken and scallions in the skillet.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
